Hello, mujhe ek issue ke liye baat karni thi. Mera last month ka EMI ECS bounce ho gaya tha kyunki maine bank account switch kiya tha aur purana account close ho gaya tha. 

Ab maine naya bank account set up kar liya hai, toh mujhe ECS mandate update karwana hai. Please mujhe kisi aise person se connect kar do jo ye mandate details update kar sake.
